<!-- Code generated by xgen. DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!-- Source: xgen/screens/src/authoring/blocks/promo.ts -->
<!--
  A contact section: a form (name, email, subject, message, consent) and, in the split layout, the ways to reach
  us beside it. Axes: layout (single, split), fields (short: email and message, full), terms (show, hide), tone
  (default, muted).
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { ContactLabels } from "./contact-form.types";
  import type { Feature } from "./feature-grid.types";

  export type ContactFormProps = {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    text: string;
    labels: ContactLabels;
    details: Feature[];
    layout?: "single" | "split";
    fields?: "short" | "full";
    terms?: "show" | "hide";
    level?: 1 | 2;
    page?: "section" | "full";
    tone?: "default" | "muted";
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Button from "../primitives/button/button.svelte";
  import Checkbox from "../primitives/checkbox/checkbox.svelte";
  import Form from "../primitives/form/form.svelte";
  import Grid from "../primitives/grid/grid.svelte";
  import Group from "../primitives/group/group.svelte";
  import Input from "../primitives/input/input.svelte";
  import Label from "../primitives/label/label.svelte";
  import LucideIcon from "../primitives/lucide-icon/lucide-icon.svelte";
  import Stack from "../primitives/stack/stack.svelte";
  import Text from "../primitives/text/text.svelte";
  import Textarea from "../primitives/textarea/textarea.svelte";
  import Field from "../components/field.svelte";
  import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.svelte";
  import { cn, tpl } from "../utils";

  let {
    id,
    title,
    text,
    labels,
    details,
    layout = "single",
    fields = "full",
    terms = "hide",
    level = 2,
    page = "section",
    tone = "default",
  }: ContactFormProps = $props();
</script>

<SectionFrame
  id={id}
  title={title}
  lead={text}
  heading={{ level }}
  tone={tone}
  density={(((page as string) === "full") ? "roomy" : "default")}
  align={(((page as string) === "full") ? "center" : "start")}
  measure={(((layout as string) === "single") ? "xl" : "default")}
>
  <Grid cols={(((layout as string) === "split") ? "1-2" : "1")} class="items-start gap-8">
    <Form class="w-full gap-4" data-testid="contact-form">
      {#if ((fields as string) === "full")}
        <Field label={labels.name} htmlFor={tpl("{0}-name", id)}>
          <Input type="text" name="name" autocomplete="name" id={tpl("{0}-name", id)} data-testid="field" />
        </Field>
      {/if}
      <Field label={labels.email} htmlFor={tpl("{0}-email", id)}>
        <Input type="email" name="email" autocomplete="email" id={tpl("{0}-email", id)} data-testid="field" />
      </Field>
      {#if ((fields as string) === "full")}
        <Field label={labels.subject} htmlFor={tpl("{0}-subject", id)}>
          <Input type="text" name="subject" id={tpl("{0}-subject", id)} data-testid="field" />
        </Field>
      {/if}
      <Field label={labels.message} htmlFor={tpl("{0}-message", id)}>
        <Textarea rows={4} name="message" id={tpl("{0}-message", id)} data-testid="field" />
      </Field>
      {#if ((terms as string) === "show")}
        <Group gap="2" align="center" class={cn("w-fit", "")}>
          <Checkbox name="consent" id={tpl("{0}-consent", id)} />
          <Label for={tpl("{0}-consent", id)} class="text-sm">
            {labels.consent}
          </Label>
        </Group>
      {/if}
      <Button variant="default" size="default" type="button" class="w-fit" data-testid="submit">
        {labels.submit}
      </Button>
    </Form>
    {#if ((layout as string) === "split")}
      <Stack gap="4" data-testid="details">
        {#each details as d (d.id)}
          <Group gap="4" align="start" data-testid="detail">
            <LucideIcon name={d.icon} size={20} />
            <Stack gap="0">
              <Text size="base" weight="semibold">
                {d.title}
              </Text>
              <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
                {d.text}
              </Text>
            </Stack>
          </Group>
        {/each}
      </Stack>
    {/if}
  </Grid>
</SectionFrame>
